method: Original deterministic exterior reconstruction from attributed map polygons, an official visitor plan and inspected photographs. Photographs are linked only; no reference pixels or third-party mesh are included.

references.inspection: Read sanitized building and building-part ways, assembled closed multipolygon relations, and inspected whole-complex and cathedral diagrams.
references.use: Signed meter frame, occupied buildings, court holes and cathedral tower/chapel positions. The precinct boundary is not a building footprint.
Separate courtyards, cathedral, churches, west/south palace wings and Golden Lane; northern Royal Garden is outside this model.
Gothic choir, chapel ring, south tower phases and Neo-Gothic completion in 1929. The page's interior photograph was not used as exterior evidence.
Old Royal Palace, Ludwig Wing, All Saints Church and later western/southern residential ranges.
99.3 m south steeple, approximately 14 m square base, double lantern dome, clock faces 4.25 and 3.85 m across. Summit lion sculpture remains unmodeled.
Two 41 m towers, 5 m north and 6.3 m south widths, triple-arched openings on two levels and stone helmet roofs.

limitations: Palace roof valleys, facade bays, smaller heights and cross-site ground levels remain approximate; map height tags are not surveyed measurements.
Golden Lane colors are approximations. Daliborka and sculptured details need additional focused references.
